posts.cooked: As of this post, I have fought all of the villians except for Iron Legacy (I think that showdown might happen tonight, right after I finish some prior work). All in all, The villians seem very challenging and fun at the same time, without them seeming too unbalanced like some of the Rook City ones. The heroes are also good, and I got to say, The Scholar is now my new favorite Hero, narrowly beating Absolute Zero, at least based off of his fluff (he's like Iroh meets The Dude meets Dumbledore! It's great!). Still working through his intricacies, but I think he'll be my go-to hero for a long time. Omnitron X is pretty cool looking, but I don't like how I play him; his innate power is WAY too tempting to use, and sometimes it doesn't work; I'll need to see how he plays in future. Chrono Ranger is also a dangerous guy to play as, as he had cards that make him VERY vurlnerable to damage, but he's quite the damage-dealer to be sure. Cannot wait to play with some of the other guys on Google Hangout (Thanks again Ronway! Sorry I've not been to them very often!)

posts.name: drstein
posts.cooked:
I was definitely lucky, but the matches were as follows:

 

WARNING: Spoiler on the mechanics

With the dreamer I had alternate visionary that was controlling her deck (and killed an illusion with a 1 shot). Alt. Wraith obliterated another one (impomptu invention + tartetting computer in starting hand), and Tempest stratosfeered the last one.

 

In all, after 1 round she flipped, and we lost no ongoings. After that she would place 1/2 illusions per round which were killed by wrath and tempest. I think visionary ended up speeding the dreamer by placing the card that brings more illusions.

 

For la capitan we had omni X who had melee/projectile/toxic plating, which ended up absorbing/redirecting most of the damage. Bunker and Absolute zero quickly set up and started dpsing la capitan. Adds were mostly killed by the environment (block), and TLTachion.

 

Haka and Absolute Zero obliterated Kismet: Abs had two of the cards that destroy 3 ongoings (hence jinx cards were gone in a sec). Haka got 2 dominions, and started getting many many cards. A haka of battle hit her for over 30 once to finish her off. I htink that the scholar just sat down and watched :)

 

Yeah, the 3 matches were lucky...and we have to go to advanced modes. But in my defense, none of us knew the decks in advance

posts.name: TheSoundOfTrees
posts.cooked:
With H=4, so far the Dreamer has been the more challenging of the ST villains. But I haven't played against Iron Legacy yet.

I hate Whipacorns ! :) Especially when them come by two, and are joined by a dark hero :( The exquisite dilemna of having high damage group attacks that could save your life and not using them...

Kismet is great fun. I like the choices she gives you each turn, and her theme of luck mastery is very well implemented. I can't wait for her "bad luck" nemesis to show ! A well deserved win for Alex ! "Ooooops, did I hurt you Fanatic ? Sorry, but this Jinx was too much..."

La Capitan has been fun too - I think the best strategy against her seems to be "kill the Captain". Except she has a crew. That keeps returning and hurting. There are times were I think of her as "the chairman - but fun!"

These three villains are now high on my list of favorite adversaries :thematic, fun to play, hard but not too hard. I like ST ! And Miss Information is a perfect villain to add to the mix.

Omnitron-X has been a surprise - I din't expect him to be so effective. It's a great tank, and he can become an incredible damage dealer with the good cards and a lot of ennemy targets... I have to test him against the Matriarch !

I like Chrono Ranger - the bounties are a great idea, and feel like a very unique mechanism. My first use of him was against Plague Rat, it was a memorable fight, as with bounties, infection bonus, nemesis bonus and a little help from Visonary, he was able to deal from 10 to 25 hp damage a turn - until the rat finally put him down. It was really a "nemesis fight" were I felt how much these two were "related" and hated each other.

I have to test the Block further, but it has been a real fun environment to play in : with a little thinking you can manage to have the cards help you a lot, until you make a mistake and the situation runs wild. Again, very thematic.

For now (I only have a few plays and still have to test he time cataclism and IL), I think it is the best of the three expansions : very thematic decks that are tactically fun to play, difficult but not overwhelming.

And then there is "I will show you what Tanking in pyjamas means" Scholar. My new favorite.
